Nothing staged or committed. The diagnosis comes from reading the code; I haven't reproduced the bug in the running app.

**Root cause:** the native OS file picker is fine. The dialog that ends up hidden is `AttachmentChoiceDialog`, the one asking "Copy into project" or "Link without copying". It opens after the user picks files.
- It is mounted once in `project_workspace.tsx`, outside all popups, so it gets the default MUI dialog z-index of 1300.
- Each card popup's z-index is 1300 plus its position in the `cardPopupService` popup stack. That stack holds every popup kind: card, action and sequence.
- Clicking into a card popup moves it to the top of that stack. So with two or more popups open, the active card popup sits at 1301 or higher and covers the dialog. The attach flow then looks stuck, because it is waiting for a choice the user can't see.
- With exactly one popup open, both sit at 1300. The dialog only wins because it was added to the page later, which is fragile.

**Planned fix:** `AttachmentChoiceDialog` subscribes to the number of open popups. It sets its z-index to `theme.zIndex.modal + popupCount + OVERLAY_LAYER_OFFSET`, which keeps it above the top popup and anything that popup opens. `OVERLAY_LAYER_OFFSET` is already defined in `resizable_popper.tsx`; it just needs to be exported. The attachment services and the popup stacking stay unchanged.

**Out of scope:** `CardDeleteDialog` has the same cause, so it can also end up behind a card popup when two or more popups are open. The doc mentions it, but the fix doesn't cover it. Should it be included or tracked as a separate card?

The attachment choice dialog now shows above every open card popup, so attaching files from a card popup no longer looks stuck. The related tests, lint and typecheck all pass. I haven't run the app to check the fix by eye.

**What changed**
- **`app/src/components/resizable_popper.tsx`**: `OVERLAY_LAYER_OFFSET` is now exported, so the dialog uses the same layering constant as the popper instead of a new number.
- **`app/src/components/editor/attachments/attachment_choice_dialog.tsx`**: the dialog watches how many popups are open (any kind: card, action or sequence). It sets its z-index (stacking order) to `theme.zIndex.modal + popupCount + OVERLAY_LAYER_OFFSET`. That is one above the top popup and anything that popup shows inside itself. The count updates live, so opening or closing a popup while the dialog is open adjusts it. With no popups open, the dialog sits at `modal + 1`, which is still above normal content.

**Tests** (in `attachment_choice_dialog.grouped.test.tsx`)
- New: with 2 card popups open, the dialog's z-index is greater than `modal + 2`. Without the fix it stays at 1300, so this test would fail.
- New: if a popup opens while the dialog is shown, the dialog's z-index rises above `modal + 1`.
- The existing "copy into project" test now also checks that no popups are open, which covers the "no popups, dialog behaves as before" criterion.
- `cardPopupService.clear()` now runs after each test so popups don't leak between tests.

**Test runs**
- `.grouped` test files only run through the file that imports them. So I ran `editor_no_mock.test.tsx` (pulls in the dialog tests) and `new_card_no_mock.test.tsx` (pulls in the new card dialog attachment tests), plus `attachment_workflow.service.test.ts` and `card_view.test.tsx`. All 4 files pass, 165 tests.
- ESLint on the changed files and `npm run typecheck` are both clean.

**Status**: the feature file `md2\design\feature_descriptions\B_270_add_file_dialog_behind_card_popup.md` is now `status: ready`.
